title: Quarterly maximum leverage with remote definition

pages:
ASTERION SYNTHETIC HOLDINGS LTD — CREDIT AGREEMENT
Section 4.1 Financial Covenant. The Borrower shall not permit the Total Leverage Ratio as of any fiscal quarter end to exceed 3.50:1.00.
Section 1.1 Definitions. Total Leverage Ratio means Total Debt divided by EBITDA for the applicable Testing Period. Testing Period means each period of four consecutive fiscal quarters.
